sentences.title: Sentences
sentences.description: Write ___ (three underscores) where players fill something in; a sentence can have several blanks. Without one, the blank goes at the end.

text.title: Sentence
text.description: e.g. "The best thing about this party is ___."

pointsPerSentence.title: Points per completed sentence
pointsPerSentence.description: A sentence counts when all its blanks are filled in.

timeLimit.title: Time limit (seconds)
timeLimit.description: Per player, from the moment they press Start.

showNames.title: Show who wrote what
showNames.description: In the presentation on the big screen, under each entry. Players can still choose to stay anonymous.
